thread:
incident-bot: PAGER — NebulonHealth (prod-vpc-07): elevated tail latency and 5xxs for text-generation endpoints. Impacting 12% of requests, started ~5m ago. Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/tenant-fallback. Paging on-call.
oncall-alex: taking it. quick snapshot? what metrics are we seeing?
incident-bot: 95th latency spiked from 120ms -> 1.8s. 5xx rate 12% (baseline <0.5%). KV cache evictions high on pool gpu-7.
eng-sre-jordan: on it. looks like aggressive eviction + background compaction on that pool. could be memory pressure from a large prompt embedded workload.
eng-runtime-lee: confirming: model nebula-2-8bit currently serving pinned tenant. memory footprint approx 42GB, eviction thrash observed. suggest pin to safe-variant nebula-2-safe (quantized, lower mem) while we stabilize.
account-ops-maya: checked NebulonHealth config — they had an enterprise VPC with dedicated pool id=prod-vpc-07, model pinned to nebula-2-8bit by account owner last week.
customer-ops-nebulon: we're seeing errors on our side, customers reporting timeouts. any ETA?
oncall-alex: plan proposal: 1) quick mitigate: pin NebulonHealth to nebula-2-safevariant and enable model-fallback routing for that tenant to fallback-cpu if GPU pool unstable. 2) reduce max-concurrency for tenant on pool to 2 while we monitor. 3) investigate root cause of cache thrash.
pm-rita: need to notify Nebulon ops before we do model pin — they may have quality concerns. liaison Maya can you ping them?
account-ops-maya: @customer-ops-nebulon pinged: "We're going to propose a temporary safe-variant pin that reduces perf but prevents errors. Can you approve automatic fallback to CPU?"
customer-ops-nebulon: approve temporary fallback to CPU if it avoids errors. Quality trade-off acceptable short-term. Please keep us posted.
eng-runtime-lee: executing admin action now. curl snippet:
```
curl -X POST https://internal.api/redwood/admin/tenants/nebulonhealth/pin \ 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \ 
 -d '{"pin_to":"nebula-2-safe","reason":"auto-mitigation: kv-eviction thrash","actor":"oncall-alex"}'
```
eng-runtime-lee: pinned to nebula-2-safevariant — response 200.
eng-sre-jordan: enabling fallback route policy: route to fallback-cpu if gpu-7 latency > 1s for 90s. applying policy now.
eng-sre-jordan: policy applied via /policies/tenants/nebulonhealth -> success.
oncall-alex: lowering tenant concurrency on pool prod-vpc-07: `set-tenant-concurrency nebulanhealth 2`
eng-runtime-lee: concurrency reduced. monitoring metrics.
incident-bot: automated checks: 5xx rate dropped to 1.3% within 60s. p95 down to 480ms.
customer-ops-nebulon: seeing significant improvement in errors. thanks. some generated outputs are slightly different — quality team is reviewing.
pm-rita: capture a quick customer-impact note: approx 15 minutes partial degradation, mitigation applied, fallback to safe-variant + CPU allowed by customer. Include this in incident summary.
eng-sre-jordan: logs show GC churn on GPU process at T0; dump attached: `gpu-7/process/oom-dump-3698887777.log` — looks like a single heavy batch from customer spike that caused KV cache eviction spiral.
eng-runtime-lee: follow-up actions: 1) add tenant-specific prefix caching limit to avoid single tenant thrash, 2) add circuit-breaker to trigger safe-variant pin automatically when eviction rate > X, 3) perf test nebula-2-safe on dedicated pool to confirm output delta.
oncall-alex: also propose a temporary rate-limit rule for NebulonHealth (soft limit) to smooth load while we tune.
account-ops-maya: confirmed with billing/contract — we can apply temporary rate-limits within SLA emergency window.
customer-ops-nebulon: please coordinate exact window with our SRE; we want a 5m heads-up before rate-limit changes.
oncall-alex: noted. will give 5m heads-up.
pm-rita: assign follow-up owner: @eng-runtime-lee to own the post-incident verification and quality regression check. @eng-sre-jordan to write immediate blameless incident note. @account-ops-maya to coordinate customer comms.
eng-runtime-lee: will run a targeted eval set of 200 representative prompts comparing nebula-2-8bit vs nebula-2-safe and share diffs by EOD.
eng-sre-jordan: I’ll draft mitigation timeline + root cause hypothesis.
incident-bot: REMINDER: if any rollback is needed, use /admin/tenants/<tenant>/rollback-pin with `force=true`.
eng-runtime-lee: once traffic stabilizes we'll unpin and let normal model selection resume. plan to re-evaluate after confidence checks show p95 < 200ms for 15m.
customer-ops-nebulon: thanks team — we will monitor and standby for quality results.
noncall-alex: handing secondary on-call to @eng-sre-jordan for next 30m while I take customer bridge.
eng-sre-jordan: ack, taking over.
pm-rita: customer comm note draft: "We applied a temporary safe-variant pin and allowed fallback to CPU to stop errors. No data was rerouted off VPC. We expect quality to be slightly different; our team is running targeted checks and will follow up." Maya please send when ready.
account-ops-maya: sent to Nebulon ops with subject: "Temporary mitigation applied — follow-up eval incoming".
incident-bot: STATUS UPDATE 15m: 5xx at 0.6%, p95 230ms, traffic normalized to 87% of baseline.
eng-runtime-lee: continuing monitoring; will post eval results here.
eng-sre-jordan: writing quick runbook addendum to avoid recurrence: tenant-specific batch limits + auto-pin threshold.
pm-rita: add remediation item: update onboarding docs for enterprise tenants to recommend prefix size limits.
eng-runtime-lee: evaluation results: 200 prompts compared — BLEU/ROUGE-ish proxies show minor deltas in 12% of samples, none catastrophic. attaching summary: `s3://redwood-incident-summaries/3698887777-eval.csv`
customer-ops-nebulon: quality looks acceptable from our spot checks. approve unpin when you see stable metrics.
eng-sre-jordan: metrics stable for 20m. proceeding with unpin in 2m and will monitor.
eng-runtime-lee: unpin executed via admin: `/admin/tenants/nebulonhealth/rollback-pin` — response 200.
incident-bot: POST-MITIGATION CHECK: 5xx 0.2%, p95 145ms.
customer-ops-nebulon: confirmed all errors cleared. thanks for the rapid response.
pm-rita: closing note: Planned follow-ups — 1) infra change: tenant-level prefix limits, 2) feature: auto-pin circuit-breaker, 3) docs: enterprise onboarding tweaks, 4) post-incident customer debrief (Maya). Assign owners in Asana.
oncall-alex: back from bridge — thanks everyone. handover complete. :tada:
eng-sre-jordan: will file postmortem draft and link into incident channel later today.
incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED for NebulonHealth at ts 3698887899."
